stdout:
usage: fleet-switchboard send [-h] [--issue ISSUE] [--interrupt]
                              [--from SENDER]
                              name text [text ...]

positional arguments:
  name           The recipient's fleet name
  text           The message

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --issue ISSUE  The issue the message is about
  --interrupt    Stop and hold orders only: abort the recipient's running turn
                 (its in-flight tool call is cut), then deliver the message as
                 a wake. Only a boss to its own worker.
  --from SENDER  Lab only: the sender's fleet name
